sources.title: Parakeet-TDT-0.6B — Core AI | Core AI model zoo
sources.snippet: Parakeet-TDT-.6B — Core AI The zoo's first transducer / TDT (RNN-T family) model — a different ASR architecture from the attention decoders (Whisper, Qwen3-ASR). nvidia/parakeet-tdt-.6b-v3 (cc-by-4.0, 600M) transcribes ≤~29 s clips in 25 European languages. It runs as three stateless .aimodel graphs + a host-driven greedy loop — no LLM runtime, just CoreAIKit's GraphModel.
